purpose: Preregister a narrowly scoped, reference-blind successor hypothesis addressing a static locality/invariance property of the frozen V162 algorithm: onset and subdivision decisions currently depend on song-global positive quantiles/q95 normalization, so evidence in an unrelated distant section can change a local decision. V164 will test and, only if song-blind fixtures support it, replace global onset-evidence normalization with deterministic local normalization while carrying all unrelated V162 generation architecture forward unchanged.

scientificIntegrity.rationale: Because the V163 terminal aggregate score was already observed before V164 preregistration, V164 does not claim reviewer score-blindness. Its admissible design evidence is therefore explicitly restricted to the pre-existing V162 contract/code/test semantics below, and no V163 score value, professional-reference content, event, measure, or failure diagnostic may enter V164 design or validation.

staticFacts: V162 positive_quantile computes its threshold from all positive finite values in the supplied envelope.
V162 support_unit computes its normalization scale from the song-envelope positive q95 population passed to it.
V162 subdivision movement uses a global positive-q55 threshold on shared onset evidence.
V162 Guitar reattack/recovery support and Bass onset/rearticulation support use the same global-population normalization primitive.

The existing V162 song-blind fixtures test weak/strong attacks, subdivision movement/order, event-step boundedness, state segmentation and caps, but do not test invariance of a local decision to remote amplitude changes.
allowedDesignEvidence.useRestriction: Only these static code/contract/test properties and future synthetic song-blind fixtures may shape V164. No V163 candidate event rows, V163 score metrics, professional-reference data, or same-song audio behavior may choose V164 thresholds or variants.

problemStatement.localityInvariant: Changing onset-envelope amplitudes sufficiently far from a target event/beat should not change that target's local supported-attack, subdivision-shift, or event-step evidence decision when the target neighborhood itself is unchanged.
problemStatement.scaleInvariant: Multiplying all onset-envelope amplitudes within a target local evidence neighborhood by a common positive scalar should not change dimensionless support/threshold decisions, apart from deterministic epsilon behavior.
problemStatement.currentArchitectureRisk: Song-global quantile/q95 normalization couples local decisions to remote dynamic range and event density, violating the intended local-evidence interpretation even without reference information.

V164ArchitectureHypotheses.H1_localSupportNormalization: Replace song-global q95 support normalization for onset evidence with a deterministic bounded local population centered on the decision neighborhood. Exact window geometry, minimum sample rules, fallback and quantile must be sealed before implementation.
V164ArchitectureHypotheses.H2_localPositiveThresholds: Replace song-global positive-quantile attack/subdivision thresholds with deterministic local positive populations appropriate to the event or beat under evaluation. Exact windows and fallbacks must be sealed before implementation.
V164ArchitectureHypotheses.H3_beatLocalSubdivisionEvidence: Subdivision movement decisions must depend only on the beat-local/shared-evidence neighborhood plus the fixed beat boundaries, so remote sections cannot alter whether an interior subdivision moves.
V164ArchitectureHypotheses.H4_eventLocalInstrumentEvidence: Guitar and Bass onset/rearticulation support must be normalized from local instrument evidence, preserving the existing source restrictions, segmentation architecture, pitch evidence, caps and admission formulas unless a later pre-code numeric contract explicitly proves a mechanically necessary normalization substitution.
V164ArchitectureHypotheses.H5_remotePerturbationInvariance: Synthetic fixtures must prove that multiplying or replacing remote envelope regions outside the sealed locality window cannot change the target local decision.
V164ArchitectureHypotheses.H6_localScaleInvariance: Synthetic fixtures must prove that positive scalar rescaling of a complete local evidence neighborhood leaves normalized decisions unchanged within deterministic floating-point tolerance.
V164ArchitectureHypotheses.H7_narrowScope: V164 is not a pitch-threshold retune, density target, register rewrite, segmentation-gap change, scorer-tolerance change, or reference-guided correction. All unrelated V162 numerics remain frozen unless the forthcoming pre-code implementation contract lists a change strictly required to implement local normalization semantics.

mandatorySongBlindValidationBeforeAnySon: Negative guard proves no professional-reference/scorer/V163-candidate/V163-score paths are opened by V164 implementation/static validation/generation/QC.
Remote-amplitude perturbation fixture: target Guitar supported-attack decision is unchanged when a distant envelope region is scaled by a very large positive factor.
Remote-amplitude perturbation fixture: target Bass onset/rearticulation support decision is unchanged when a distant envelope region is scaled by a very large positive factor.
Remote-amplitude perturbation fixture: target beat subdivision movement and selected frame are unchanged when distant shared-envelope regions are scaled by a very large positive factor.
Local positive-scale fixture: multiplying the full target local neighborhood by at least two distinct positive scalars preserves normalized support/threshold decisions.
Local zero/sparse fallback fixture: empty or insufficient positive local populations produce the sealed deterministic fallback without NaN/nonfinite output.
Boundary fixture: locality windows at the start/end of an envelope remain bounded and deterministic.
Existing V162 synthetic segmentation/register/state/grid-cap fixtures remain behaviorally identical except where their expected metadata explicitly reflects local-normalization provenance.
JSON-native receipt normalization and nonfinite rejection remain intact.
Static proof pitch inference cannot execute before fresh successor timebase QC PASS.
Absence proof for all V164 runtime artifacts and generation workflow before any arm.
